verdict.rationale: Zep generates AI-derived content from your data: natural-language thread summaries that it creates and updates incrementally, and auto-composed Context Blocks drawn from edges, nodes, observations and summaries. However, these are retrieval artifacts returned through the API for your own agents to use, not insights or suggestions surfaced to the user inside the product. Missing for 10: in-product (dashboard) insight or suggestion surfaces, proactive recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
